synthesis.body: `package.py`'s `packs/**` archive walk applies no deny-list, and agentbundle's own tests copy `packs/` into temp dirs and build. One `npm install` in a skill with a package.json adds ~10k gitignored files there, and the suite slowed by more than an order of magnitude — with zero signal, because node_modules/ is gitignored so nothing in review or `git status` shows it. Remove it after any local JS verification.

title: A local `npm install` under packs/ slows every test that builds a catalogue
